name: Kupu Aina Corps
what_you_do: Paid green jobs in nature care, farming, trail repair and green tech. You work with host groups across Hawaii and get career help and certificates.
who_can_apply: Most positions need participants to be 17 to 38 for the whole term. A small number of positions have no upper age limit.
pay_detail: $20 an hour, plus health insurance for 20+ hours a week, a retention bonus ($200 to $800) and paid time off.
duration: 6 or 12 month terms, part-time (20 hours a week) or full-time (40 hours a week)
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-2027 term are open now. Closing date not stated on the page.
how_to_apply: Apply online with the Apply link on the Kupu Aina Corps page. Look at the host sites you can pick.
notes: Most positions take ages 17 to 38 for the whole term. Jobs are on Hawaii Island, Kauai, Maui, Molokai and Oahu. The older HYCC Summer program (17 and up) is paused. Kupu also runs the Conservation Leadership Development Program. Hawaii requires a child labor certificate (work permit) for working minors under 18. It is free. It is a Certificate of Employment for 14 and 15, and a Certificate of Age for 16 and 17.
